summary: Full-stack testing of Assistify OS MVP. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass (GET /api/, /api/agents returns 4 agents without system_message, /api/chat/stream 200 SSE, invalid agent 404, empty history returns []). Frontend: Login->Dashboard routing works, all 10 sidebar nav items route correctly and each page renders its data-testid container. Dashboard has 4 stat cards. Clients page has search + Add Client. Tasks: checkbox toggle works (unchecked->checked), filter-all/active/done buttons work. Projects: 4 kanban columns (In Progress, Review, Completed, Blocked) with project cards. AI Agents: 4 agent cards loaded from /api/agents, chat-agent-copilot navigates to /ai-chat. AI Chat: chat-input + chat-send fires POST /api/chat/stream, user message renders (AI budget error is expected). Settings: all 5 vertical tabs switch, Save profile shows 'Profile saved' toast.
critical_code_review_comments: Projects kanban columns and project cards lack data-testid attributes (only projects-page and new-project-btn have them). Consider adding kanban-col-<status> and project-card-<id> testids for future automation.

Backend /api/chat/stream: on exception in LLM streaming, user message is already persisted but no assistant error message is stored. Consider persisting an error marker or letting frontend show error toast so users know AI failed.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY read via os.environ['...'] at import time — fails fast which is good, but no explicit health endpoint to verify key validity.
seed_data_creation: None. Static mock data in frontend; MongoDB only stores chat messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified. AI response streaming returns budget error (expected due to $0 LLM key). Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py. Kanban columns identified via h2/h3 headings since no data-testid. Login is static — clicking data-testid=login-submit routes to /dashboard without validation.
